name: Vikram Thermo (India) Limited
about: Vikram Thermo (India) Limited engages in the manufacture, marketing, and export of pharmaceutical excipients and chemicals in India and internationally. The company offers pharmaceutical polymer products, such as DRUGCOAT, a methacrylic co-polymer-based pharma polymer used for enteric and protective coating, taste masking, and sustained release formulation; DRCOAT, provides aqueous and non-aqueous based tablet coating system; and diphenyl oxide, an aromatic chemical. It also provides cosmetic polymers comprising AQUAPOL polymer, an acrylic acid polymer; and APION cross-linked polymers. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
